channel.title: Enforcement Actions | Consumer Financial Protection Bureau

item.title: Synapse Financial Technologies, Inc.
item.description: On August 21, 2025, the Bureau commenced an adversary proceeding and filed a complaint and proposed stipulated final judgment and order against Synapse Financial Technologies, Inc.

item.title: Wise US Inc.
item.description: On January 30, 2025, the Bureau issued an order against Wise US Inc., a nonbank remittance transfer provider headquartered in New York, New York.

item.title: American Honda Finance Corporation
item.description: On January 17, 2025, the Bureau issued an order against American Honda Finance Corporation to address its violations relating to its furnishing of inaccurate consumer reporting information.

item.title: Equifax, Inc. and Equifax Information Services LLC
item.description: On January 17, 2025, the Bureau issued an order against Equifax, Inc. and Equifax Information Services LLC, one of the largest consumer reporting agencies in the country.

item.title: Draper & Kramer Mortgage Corporation
item.description: On January 17, 2025, the Bureau filed a complaint and proposed consent order to resolve allegations against Draper & Kramer Mortgage Corporation (Draper), a non-depository mortgage lender based in Downers Grove, Illinois.

item.title: Block, Inc.
item.description: On January 16, 2025, the Bureau issued an order against Block, Inc. (Block), a nonbank headquartered in Oakland, California which operates Cash App, a mobile payments application through which consumers can send and receive money through peer-to-peer transfers.

item.title: Capital One, National Association, and Capital One Financial Corporation
item.description: On January 14, 2025, the Bureau filed a lawsuit against Capital One, N.A., a national bank with over $480 billion in assets, and its parent holding company, Capital One Financial Corp.

item.title: Experian Information Solutions, Inc.
item.description: On January 7, 2025, the Bureau filed a lawsuit against Experian Information Solutions, Inc., one of the largest consumer reporting agencies in the country.

item.title: Vanderbilt Mortgage & Finance, Inc.
item.description: On January 6, 2025, the Bureau filed a lawsuit against Vanderbilt Mortgage & Finance, Inc.

item.title: Walmart Inc., and Branch Messenger, Inc.
item.description: On December 23, 2024, the Bureau filed a complaint against Walmart Inc., and Branch Messenger, Inc.

item.title: Rocket Homes Real Estate LLC, dba Rocket Homes; JMG Holding Partners LLC, dba The Jason Mitchell Group; 45 real estate brokerage affiliates; and Jason Mitchell
item.description: On December 23, 2024, the Bureau filed a lawsuit against Rocket Homes Real Estate, LLC, doing business as Rocket Homes, JMG Holding Partners LLC, doing business as The Jason Mitchell Group, 45 of its affiliates (collectively, The Mitchell Group), and Jason Mitchell, the majority owner and Chief Executive Officer of The Mitchell Group.

item.title: Early Warning Services, LLC; Bank of America, N.A.; JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.; Wells Fargo Bank, N.A
item.description: On December 20, 2024, the Bureau filed a lawsuit against Early Warning Services, LLC (EWS), Bank of America, N.A., JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., and Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., claiming they failed to safeguard the Zelle network from fraud and other defects, which resulted in hundreds of millions of dollars in consumer losses.

item.title: Performant Recovery, Inc.
item.description: On December 9, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against Performant Recovery, Inc., to address its unlawful collection activities involving student-loan borrowers who were attempting to bring their student loans out of default.

item.title: Comerica Bank
item.description: On December 6, 2024, the Bureau filed a complaint against Comerica Bank. Comerica is a Texas banking association headquartered in Dallas, Texas, and is a subsidiary of Comerica Incorporated, one of the largest banking associations in the country.

item.title: Global Tel Link Corporation d/b/a ViaPath Technologies; Telmate, LLC d/b/a ViaPath Technologies; and TouchPay Holdings, LLC d/b/a GTL Financial Services
item.description: On November 14, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against Global Tel Link Corporation, d/b/a ViaPath Technologies, and its subsidiaries Telmate, LLC, d/b/a ViaPath Technologies, and TouchPay Holdings, LLC, d/b/a GTL Financial Services.

item.title: Navy Federal Credit Union
item.description: On November 7, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against Navy Federal Credit Union, headquartered in Vienna, Virginia.

item.title: VyStar Credit Union
item.description: On October 31, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against Vystar Credit Union.

item.title: Apple Inc.
item.description: On October 23, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against Apple Inc.

item.title: Goldman Sachs Bank USA
item.description: On October 23, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against Goldman Sachs Bank USA.

item.title: Climb Credit, Inc.; Climb Investco, LLC; Climb GS Loan Fund 2018-1, LLC; 1/0 Holdco LLC; and 1/0 Capital LLC
item.description: On October 17, 2024, the Bureau filed a lawsuit against Climb Credit, Inc.; its wholly owned subsidiary Climb Investco, LLC; its wholly owned sub-subsidiary Climb GS Loan Fund 2018-1, LLC; and the originators, initial owners, and initial operators of these entities, 1/0 Holdco LLC and 1/0 Capital LLC.

item.title: Fairway Independent Mortgage Corporation
item.description: On October 15, 2024, the Bureau, together with the United States Department of Justice, filed a complaint and proposed consent order to resolve their allegations against Fairway Independent Mortgage Corporation.

item.title: Ejudicate, Inc., d/b/a Brief
item.description: On October 10, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against Ejudicate, Inc., d/b/a Brief, a company based in Los Angeles, California.

item.title: Reliant Holdings, Inc. d/b/a Horizon Card Services; and Robert Kane
item.description: On September 13, 2024, the Bureau filed a lawsuit against Reliant Holdings, Inc., d/b/a Horizon Card Services and Robert Kane, its sole shareholder, owner, and chief executive officer.

item.title: TD Bank, N.A.
item.description: On September 11, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against TD Bank, N.A., a national bank headquartered in Cherry Hill, New Jersey.

item.title: New Day Financial, LLC
item.description: On August 29, 2024, the Bureau issued an order against New Day Financial, LLC (NewDay USA), a nonbank direct mortgage lender headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida, specializing in offering refinance mortgage loans guaranteed by the United States Department of Veterans Affairs.
